interpreted_request: 调研可用于 Java 后端的 Agent 项目，重点分析 alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba 的使用与部署资料，并区分文档声明与实测结果。

candidates.summary: 面向 Java 开发者的 Agentic AI 框架，包含 Agent Framework、Graph 运行时、Admin 平台与 Spring Boot Starters；README 给出 JDK 17+ 前置条件、Maven 依赖坐标与 ChatBot 启动命令，examples 目录含可运行的配置样例。

claims.text: README 声明需 JDK 17+，ChatBot 示例通过 ./mvnw -pl examples/chatbot spring-boot:run 启动并访问 localhost:8080/chatui。
示例配置 application.yml 使用 DASHSCOPE_API_KEY 与 qwen-plus 模型，并配置 A2A Nacos 注册发现（需 Nacos 3.x+）及 MCP streamable-http/SSE 连接。
元数据：Apache-2.0 许可，约 1.1 万 stars，最近提交 2026-10-07，最新正式版 v1.1.2.2（2026-03-10），另有预发布 v2.0.0-M1.1。

assessments.reason: 仓库语言为 Java，README 要求 JDK 17+，依赖坐标为 com.alibaba.cloud.ai 的 Maven 构件，示例通过 spring-boot:run 启动。
README 描述 Agent Framework 内置 SequentialAgent/ParallelAgent/RoutingAgent/LoopAgent 等编排模式，Graph 提供持久化与流式运行时。
README 提供快速开始步骤、依赖片段与官方文档链接；examples/documentation 的 application.yml 展示 DashScope、A2A Nacos、MCP 客户端等配置项。

candidates.decision_reason: Java 语言、Agent 编排能力与文档/示例配置齐备，维护活跃（最近提交在 180 天窗口内），适合作为 Java 后端 Agent 选型首选；实际运行效果未实测。
unknowns: 未实际运行示例，启动成功率、性能与资源占用未实测
Admin 平台与 Studio 的部署方式未读取源码验证
v2.0.0-M1.1 为预发布版本，稳定性未确认

conclusion: 在已核验范围内，alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba 是唯一取得文件原文证据的候选：Java 语言、JDK 17+、Maven 依赖与 spring-boot:run 启动步骤、DashScope/A2A Nacos/MCP 配置样例齐备，维护活跃，推荐作为 Java 后端 Agent 选型首选。搜索另见 langchain4j/langchain4j、agents-flex/agents-flex、mateaix/mateclaw 等候选，但受分析额度限制未深入核验，结论待确认。所有运行效果、性能与部署实测均未进行，README 与配置中的能力属文档/源码声明。
unknowns: 未实际运行任何候选项目，启动成功率、性能、资源占用均未实测
Admin/Studio 平台部署方式未验证
langchain4j、agents-flex、mateclaw 未做仓库内证据核验

1: # [Spring AI Alibaba](https://java2ai.com) 2: 3: [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202-4EB1BA.svg)](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.html) 4: [![CI Status](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/actions/workflows/build-and-test.yml) 5: [![Ask DeepWiki](https://deepwiki.com/badge.svg)](https://deepwiki.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba) 6: [![Maven Central](https://img.shields.io/badge/Maven%20Central-v1.1.2.2-blue)](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/com.alibaba.cloud.ai/spring-ai-alibaba/1.1.2.2) 7: [![gitleaks badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/protected%20by-gitleaks-blue)](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks) 8: 9: 10:

11: A production-ready framework for building Agentic, Workflow, and Multi-agent applications. 12:

13:

14: Agent Framework Docs, 15: Graph Docs, 16: Spring AI, 17: Examples. 18:

19: 20: 21: ## Architecture 22: 23:

24: 25:

26: 27: **Spring AI Alibaba Admin** is a one-stop Agent platform that supports visualized Agent development, observability, evaluation, and MCP management, etc. It also integrates with open-source low-code platforms like Dify, enabling rapid migration from DSL to Spring AI Alibaba project. 28: 29: **Spring AI Alibaba Agent Framework** is an agent development framework that can quickly develop agents with built-in **Context Engineering** and **Human In The Loop** support. For scenarios requiring more complex process control, Agent Framework offers built-in workflows like `SequentialAgent`, `ParallelAgent`, `RoutingAgent`, `LoopAgent`. 30: 31: **Spring AI Alibaba Graph** serves as the underlying runtime of the Agent Framework, providing essential capabilities such as persistence, workflow orchestration, and streaming required for long-running stateful agents. Compared to the Agent Framework, users can build more flexible multi-agent workflows based on the Graph API. 32: 33: ## Core Features 34: 35: * **[Multi-Agent Orchestration](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/tree/main/examples/multiagent-patterns)**: Compose multiple agents with built-in patterns including `SequentialAgent`, `ParallelAgent`, `RoutingAgent`, and `LoopAgent` for complex task execution. 36: 37: * **[Multimodal Support](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/tree/main/examples/multimodal)**: ReactAgent with text and media input (image understanding). ReactAgent with tool based image or audio generation. 38: 39: * **[Voice Agent](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/tree/main/examples/voice-agent)**: WebSocket-based real-time voice agent that supports streaming audio or text input and responds with generated audio. 40: 41: * **[Context Engineering](https://java2ai.com/docs/frameworks/agent-framework/tutorials/hooks)**: Built-in best practices for context engineering policies to improve agent reliability and performance, including human-in-the-loop, context compaction, context editing, model & tool call limit, tool retry, planning, dynamic tool selection. 42: 43: * **[Graph-based Workflow](https://java2ai.com/docs/frameworks/graph-core/quick-start)**: Graph based workflow runtime and api for conditional routing, nested graphs, parallel execution, and state management. Export workflows to PlantUML and Mermaid formats. 44: 45: * **[A2A Support](https://java2ai.com/docs/frameworks/agent-framework/advanced/a2a)**: Agent-to-Agent communication support with Nacos integration, enabling distributed agent coordination and collaboration across services. 46: 47: * **[Rich Model, Tool and MCP Support](https://java2ai.com/integration/chatmodels/dashScope)**: Leveraging core concepts of Spring AI, supports multiple LLM providers (DashScope, OpenAI, etc.), tool calling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). 48: 49: * **[One-stop Agent Platform](https://java2ai.com/ecosystem/admin/quick-start)**: Build agent in a visualized way, deploy agent without code or export as a standalone java project. 50: 51:

52: 53:

54: 55: ## Getting Started 56: 57: ### Prerequisites 58: 59: * Requires JDK 17+. 60: * Choose your LLM provider and get the API-KEY. 61: 62: ### Quickly Run a ChatBot 63: 64: There's a ChatBot example provided by the community at [examples/chatbot](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/tree/main/examples/chatbot). 65: 66: 1. Download the code. 67: 68: ```shell 69: git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba.git 70: cd spring-ai-alibaba 71: ``` 72: 73: 2. Start the ChatBot. 74: 75: Before starting, set API-KEY first (visit Aliyun Bailian to get API-KEY): 76: ```shell 77: # this example uses 'spring-ai-alibaba-starter-dashscope', visit https://java2ai.com to learn how to use OpenAI/DeepSeek. 78: export AI_DASHSCOPE_API_KEY=your-api-key 79: ``` 80: 81: ```shell 82: # Maven installation is optional when using mvnw. 83: ./mvnw -pl examples/chatbot spring-boot:run 84: ``` 85: 86: 3. Chat with ChatBot. 87: 88: Open the browser and visit [http://localhost:8080/chatui/index.html](http://localhost:8080/chatui/index.html) to chat with the ChatBot. 89: 90:

91: 92:

93: 94: ## Chatbot Code Explained 95: 96: 1. Add dependencies 97: 98: ```xml 99: 100: 101: com.alibaba.cloud.ai 102: spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework 103: 1.1.2.0 104: 105: 106: 107: com.alibaba.cloud.ai 108: spring-ai-alibaba-starter-dashscope 109: 1.1.2.1 110: 111: 112: ``` 113: 114: 2. Define Chatbot 115: 116: For more details of how to write a Chatbot, please check the [Quick Start](https://java2ai.com/docs/quick-start) on our official website. 117: 118: ## 📚 Documentation 119: * [Overview](https://java2ai.com/docs/overview) - High level overview of the framework 120: * [Quick Start](https://java2ai.com/docs/quick-start) - Get started with a simple agent 121: * [Agent Framework Tutorials](https://java2ai.com/docs/frameworks/agent-framework/tutorials/agents) - Step by step tutorials 122: * [Use Graph API to Build Complex Workflows](https://java2ai.com/docs/frameworks/agent-framework/advanced/context-engineering) - In-depth user guide for building multi-agent and workflows 123: * [Spring AI Basics](https://java2ai.com/ecosystem/spring-ai/reference/concepts) - Ai Application basic concepts, including ChatModel, MCP, Tool, Messages, etc. 124: * [Chat Memory](https://docs.spring.io/spring-ai/reference/api/chatclient.html#chat-memory) - Spring AI reference for chat memory repositories and usage 125: 126: ## Project Structure 127: 128: This project consists of several core components: 129: 130: * spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework: A multi-agent framework designed for building intelligent agents with built-in context engineering best practices. 131: * spring-ai-alibaba-graph: The underlying runtime for Agent Framework. We recommend developers to use Agent Framework but it's totally fine to use the Graph API directly. 132: * spring-ai-alibaba-admin: A one-stop Agent platform that supports visualized Agent development, observability, evaluation, and MCP management, etc. 133: * spring-ai-alibaba-studio: The embedded ui for quickly debugging agent in a visualized way. 134: * spring-boot-starters: Starters integrating Agent Framework with Nacos to provide A2A and dynamic config features. 135: 136: ## Spring AI Alibaba Ecosystem 137: Repository | Description | ⭐ 138: --- | --- | --- 139: | [Spring AI Alibaba Graph](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/tree/main/spring-ai-alibaba-graph-core) | A low-level orchestration framework and runtime for building, managing, and deploying long-running, stateful agents. | ![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba?style=for-the-badge&label=) 140: | [Spring AI Alibaba Admin](https://github.com/spring-ai-alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba-admin) | Local visualization toolkit for the development of agent applications, supporting project management, runtime visualization, tracing, and agent evaluation. | ![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/spring-ai-alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba-admin?style=for-the-badge&label=)

Java 语言、Agent 编排能力与文档/示例均有证据支撑；最近提交 2026-10-07 在 180 天窗口内（相对 2026-11-12）。已注明实际运行效果未实测，表述恰当。
README 第 59 行要求 JDK 17+，第 83 行给出 ./mvnw -pl examples/chatbot spring-boot:run，第 88 行访问 localhost:8080/chatui/index.html。注意原文路径含 /index.html，但表述为文档声明，可接受。
application.yml 第 8-12 行配置 DASHSCOPE_API_KEY 与 qwen-plus，第 14-23 行配置 A2A Nacos（注释注明需 Nacos 3.x+），第 36-52 行配置 MCP streamable-http 与 SSE 连接，均有实际代码依据。
元数据快照显示 Apache-2.0、11139 stars、pushed_at 2026-10-07；maintenance 快照显示 v1.1.2.2（2026-03-10，非预发布）与 v2.0.0-M1.1（2026-06-25，预发布），与表述一致。
元数据显示语言为 Java，README 要求 JDK 17+，依赖坐标 com.alibaba.cloud.ai 与 spring-boot:run 启动方式均有依据。
README 第 29 行明确列出 SequentialAgent/ParallelAgent/RoutingAgent/LoopAgent，第 31 行说明 Graph 提供持久化、编排与流式能力。属文档声明层级，表述未超出。
README 提供快速开始、依赖片段与官方文档链接；application.yml 展示 DashScope、A2A Nacos、MCP 客户端配置项，均有依据。

结论中关于 alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba 的 Java 语言、JDK 17+、Maven 依赖与 spring-boot:run 启动步骤、DashScope/A2A Nacos/MCP 配置样例、维护活跃等表述均有对应证据支持（ev-166e4c71cd94 元数据、ev-7b16e513218a README、ev-2f1773ba4f3f 配置、ev-afcb7d65f33e 维护快照）。结论同时明确区分了文档/源码声明与未实测，并说明其他候选未深入核验、结论待确认，未将已读范围外推为不存在，也未把局部能力推广为整个项目已验证。'唯一取得文件原文证据'的表述与所提供证据范围一致，未发现无依据的新增事实。
